description: This file defines a React functional component called `SearchToolView` which renders a detailed view of a search tool, including its metadata, copy-to-clipboard functionality, and a nested `SearchToolTester` component. It manages local UI states such as copy notifications and interacts with utility functions and external UI component libraries.

methods.name: SearchToolView
methods.description: A React functional component that renders the detailed view of a search tool, including its properties and actions like copying ID and name.
